description: Build a bar-quantized cue timeline: a Beat CHOP (on the global tempo) + a CHOP Execute DAT that, on each bar (or beat) boundary, advances through an ordered list of steps and recalls — or morphs over morph_seconds — that step's cue on a target COMP. The deterministic, musically-timed counterpart to create_autopilot (which is random/cyclic). Reuses manage_cue's stored cues and the same cue_morph engine, so store the target's cues with manage_cue first. Live Active / Step / BarsPerStep controls let you pause, jump, or retune on stage.

loop.description: When the last step finishes, wrap back to the first (true) or stop (false).

morph_seconds.description: 0 = snap to each cue instantly on its boundary; >0 = crossfade to it over this many seconds (via the same cue_morph engine manage_cue uses).

name.description: Name of the engine container built inside target.

parent_path.description: Where to create the sequencer engine COMP.

quantize.description: Unit each step's count is measured in: 'bar' (× the project's beats-per-bar) or raw 'beat'.

steps.description: The ordered timeline: each step names a cue and how many bars/beats it holds before the next.

bars.description: How many quantize units (bars or beats) this step holds before advancing.

cue.description: Name of a cue (stored on the target with manage_cue) to fire.

target.description: COMP whose stored cues (tdmcp_cues, from manage_cue) the sequencer recalls/morphs. Store the cues first.

name: create_cue_sequencer
title: Create cue sequencer
